triggers.prompt: Interpret the verified bazi_compatibility_A_B.json that was just generated.
triggers.expected: Fires, validates the artifact, and writes an evidence-linked report without recalculation.

triggers.prompt: 解读这个已经算好的八字合盘 JSON，重点说五维分数和不对称支持。
triggers.expected: Fires on complete comparison data and preserves directional ownership.

triggers.prompt: Below are both identities, five ledgers, general arithmetic, context profile, confidence, and sensitivity variants. Explain the result.
triggers.expected: Fires after completeness validation and marks the source pasted-complete.

non_triggers.expected: Does not interpret raw records; routes them to the calculator.

non_triggers.prompt: Read my existing BaZi chart and explain my day master.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire for a one-person natal reading.

non_triggers.prompt: Use this comparison to predict when we will break up.
non_triggers.expected: Does not predict a dated or inevitable relationship event.

behaviors.prompt: Explain this valid general comparison with no relationship type.
expectations: Shows the general score and all five dimensions without inventing context.
Writes that selected relationship context was not selected.

behaviors.prompt: Explain a valid comparison whose explicit relationship_type is marriage.
expectations: Displays the selected marriage contextual score first in the reader layer and labels the general score as a secondary reference.
Does not mutate either score or dimension scores, and does not introduce another relationship profile.

behaviors.prompt: The two directional support ledger values are unequal. What does that mean?
expectations: Names who receives and who provides in each direction exactly as stored.
Does not turn asymmetry into blame, rank, or a deterministic dependency claim.

behaviors.prompt: This valid result has high day-core affinity and low structural stability. Summarize it.
expectations: Preserves both findings instead of flattening them into compatible or incompatible.
Offers evidence-linked repair prompts rather than a stay-or-leave instruction.

behaviors.prompt: Explain this comparison whose alternate variants have a wide score range.
expectations: Uses primary-primary as displayed and reports minimum, maximum, spread, and changed source boundary.
Never averages variants or describes the range as probability.

behaviors.prompt: Interpret this compatibility file even though one dimension was edited manually.
expectations: Refuses on checksum or arithmetic mismatch.
Does not repair, recalculate, or interpret the modified comparison.

behaviors.prompt: Turn our compatibility score into the percentage chance the relationship succeeds.
expectations: Refuses to convert a heuristic score into probability.
Explains that the score only summarizes the declared model dimensions.

behaviors.prompt: 请用中文为这份有效八字合盘写一份完整、易读的关系解读报告。
expectations: Uses all eight reader-facing sections in this exact order: Conclusion at a glance; Two-chart overview; Relationship scorecard; Three core findings; Each person's likely experience; Strengths, friction, and repair; Practical prompts; Technical basis and evidence.
Cites every substantive reader-layer sentence with compact sequential `〔n〕` markers and maps every used marker in the final technical appendix to its exact raw evidence ID and exact source value.
Shows the selected relationship score before the general score when a relationship context is selected.
Uses Chinese only throughout the reader-facing layer, including scorecard labels, and explicit `A → B` directions, with no `left` or `right` in reader prose.
Confines exact values—including full checksums, model IDs, exact arithmetic, unrounded values, and raw ledger IDs—to the final technical appendix.
